text:
Maya: Heads up — opened a PR to refresh the Quickstart hello-app. It switches the examples to the new auth flow (REDWOOD_API_KEY + short-lived tokens) and updates deployment snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824

Sam: Nice. Can you include both POSIX and PowerShell env examples? People keep tripping over export syntax on Windows.

Maya: Yup — added both. Example in the quickstart: 
```
# mac/linux
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-..."
# windows (PowerShell)
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = 'sk-...'
```

Liam: Also remember to update the SDK examples — we standardized on `authToken` in SDK v2. The old `apiKey` prop is still supported but we should encourage `authToken`.

Oliver: Agreed. Show both in the snippet, but prefer `authToken` in the one-line quickstart. Add a short migration note for existing users.

Maya: Done. JS snippet now reads:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ authToken: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```
And a one-line comment: `// old: { apiKey: ... }` for migration.

Emily: The deploy section still referenced `redwood/quickstart:latest`. Can we pin to `redwood/quickstart:v2.1.0` and add a tiny k8s manifest as an example?

Maya: Good catch — updated to `v2.1.0` and added a minimal Deployment + Service YAML. Also added a `docker-compose.yml` sample with an `.env` file example.

Sam: Can you paste the docker-compose sample inline in the thread? Reviewer asked for copy-pasteable content so newcomers can run it locally.

Maya: Pasted below:
```yaml
version: '3.7'
services:
  hello:
    image: redwood/quickstart:v2.1.0
    ports:
      - '8080:8080'
    env_file: .env
```
And `.env` example:
```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
REDWOOD_REGION=us-west-2
```

Liam: LGTM. One nit: the auth troubleshooting section should include a `401` example and the suggested CLI command to refresh tokens, e.g. `redwood tokens refresh`.

Maya: Added the `401` example and the CLI snippet. Also included a tiny curl example to inspect auth headers: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" http://localhost:8080/health`.

Docs Bot: automated link-checker found a broken link to `/guides/deployments/private` and created a redirect entry — fixed in a follow-up commit.

Oliver: I'll do a final pass for clarity and tone. @Maya can you squash the commits into one logical change and add a changelog entry under `docs/CHANGELOG.md`?

Maya: Yep — will squash and add changelog. Targeting merge tomorrow after QA.

Emily: Thanks! I'll run the examples locally and report any issues. :+1:
